title: nephelium pinnatum
intro: Nephelium pinnatum, commonly known as the Rambai, is a species of fruit-bearing tree in the family Sapindaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian cultures for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Nephelium pinnatum include its ability to treat gastrointestinal issues, fever reduction, and wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Nephelium pinnatum contribute to its therapeutic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
